description:
Register an existing wallet for 3 free escrows by proving ownership.

Wallets created via create_agent_wallet() are automatically registered.
If you created your wallet elsewhere (Wallet.create(), Privy, Xaman, etc.),
call this to claim the same 3 free escrows.

tx_hash.description: Hash of an XRPL AccountSet tx you submitted from wallet_address with a Memo containing the challenge string from get_wallet_verification_challenge(). This proves you own the wallet.
tx_hash.title: Verification Transaction Hash

wallet_address.description: Your XRPL wallet address (r...) to register for the free tier.
wallet_address.title: XRPL Wallet Address
